normalizationSpec.notes: Generate with scripts/normalize-gss-2024.mjs from a GSS 2024 CSV export that uses numeric GSS codes (e.g., from the GSS Data Explorer or an SDA export). TRUST, HELPFUL, and FAIR are mapped to a binary positive share with 'Depends' (code 3) and missing codes (0/8/9) treated as null. CONINC is assumed to be constant 1986 dollars and is converted to current (2024) dollars for income-band mapping using a CPI-U multiplier; the default is 2.862 and may be overridden with --income-multiplier.
